biggest_catch: The $50 bill credit is never redeemable for cash and posts ~30 days after the referral qualifies; if the friend's first bill fails or they don't stay active 30 days, no credit is issued.
catches: Both sides earn a $50.00 bill credit per successful Qualified Referral; bill credits are never redeemable for cash refunds.

Friend must be a new GoodCharlie residential customer: enroll online on a 12+ month plan via the participant's unique referral link, stay active at least 30 days, pay the first full bill, and have no delinquencies.
Participant must be an active GoodCharlie residential customer in good standing (current on payments, not subject to disconnection/collection).
No limit on earning, but if a participant earns over $599 in a calendar year they may be required to fill out a W-9 for tax purposes.
GoodCharlie may terminate or change the program at any time; special promotions may alter the incentive amount.
GoodCharlie is a Texas electricity retailer; bill credit is savings on planned energy spending, never income.
